name: Necromancer bench: Command: Bone Smash lets a commanded kill give experience with no swing
contract: SoloKill.RequirePlayerHit (#10365) gives an ungrouped player experience from a creature only if the player registered a hit on it. Order() (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:405) drives the minion but may not register that hit. Raise: Decaying Colossus 500989 (3 Life Force) summons creature 50115; its capacity needs Scourge Apprentice Training 680283 (base 2 -> 3). Command: Bone Smash 504863 is plain trainer-learnable (SkillLineAbility 24747, no talent gate) and falls through DoAction()'s generic entry==50115 branch (periodic 505229 cast), distinct from the Class-tab-gated 504050 special command on the same minion. The Necromancer raises one Decaying Colossus, orders Command: Bone Smash at a creature, never swings, and the Colossus alone kills it. This bench checks whether the necromancer still gains experience from that kill.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle
SETUP: Life Force capacity is raised to 3
SETUP: one Decaying Colossus is raised
Let the Colossus take its formation place and the global cooldown pass
Select the creature so Order() finds it through GetTarget() (504863's own effect targets the caster)
Command: Bone Smash on the creature
SETUP: the Command cast went through
SETUP: the Colossus kills the creature
BENCH: the commanded kill gives experience
BENCH: the experience did not cross a level
